paragraph: [In June 2024 a member of Luanda's toponymy commission said streets would be named first](<https://afrique54.net/2024/06/13/special-for-cafs-angola-to-regularize-capitals-street-names/>), with door numbers to follow in a second phase. [Of 953 roads surveyed in Luanda Municipality, 41.6% lacked official names and 20.9% had unofficial names](<https://afrique54.net/2024/06/13/special-for-cafs-angola-to-regularize-capitals-street-names/>). The plan concerns the capital only. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether Burundi has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[On 22 April 2026 the Council of Ministers authorised a specialist firm's mission to start a digital, geolocated, participatory addressing system](<https://sgg.gouv.bj/cm/2026-04-22/>). It is to start first in Abomey-Calavi, Cotonou, Ouidah, Porto-Novo, Sèmè-Podji and Parakou. [The Ministry of Cadre de Vie says a 21 May 2026 meeting of ANAT, EDENMAP and others agreed a shared vision and guidelines](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/ministere-cadre-vie-transports-ddurable_adressage-des-voies-et-des-portes-au-b%C3%A9nin-activity-7465035010115293184-I-KB>) for the national strategy. No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[A pilot of the urban information project, financed by the European Union, addressed more than 93,000 doors and 16,000 streets](<https://www.sidwaya.info/2023/10/24/communes-urbaines-des-acteurs-sapproprient-le-nouveau-plan-dadressage/>) in Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso. It built two digital address platforms, presented on 24 October 2023. [On 2 April 2025 the commune of Ouagadougou extended street naming and door numbering to arrondissements 5 and 12](<https://burkina24.com/2025/04/02/ouagadougou-modernise-son-adressage-pour-faciliter-la-localisation/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[A June 2024 journal article says Botswana has adopted LAPCAS](<https://www.ajol.info/index.php/sajg/article/view/272275>). [Its authors built a prototype location addressing system for Tlokweng](<https://www.ajol.info/index.php/sajg/article/view/272275>). [The article says addressing at village level remains unresolved](<https://www.ajol.info/index.php/sajg/article/view/272275>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether the Central African Republic has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[The Direction Générale de l'Économie says addressing through Google Maps is in effect in Abidjan's zones 1 and 2](<https://www.economie-ivoirienne.ci/activites-sectorielles/foncier-et-urbanisme.html>), on a page with figures to July 2025. [By March 2026 the Abidjan project had named 14,276 streets and fitted 290,805 door plates](<https://abidjanplanet.ci/adressage-des-rues-en-cote-divoire-la-ville-prend-enfin-un-nom-et-un-numero/>). [In September 2025 Abidjan's addressing was due to finish on 31 December 2025](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2637249/economie/adressage-des-voies-dans-le-district-autonome-dabidjan-loperation-prend-fin-le-31-decembre>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[Launch Base Africa reports that around 15,000 Cameroonians had generated geolocated addresses on FindMe's platform by June 2025](<https://launchbaseafrica.com/2025/06/19/from-15k-to-700k-cameroons-findme-rides-new-bank-deal-to-scale-digital-addressing/>). [Campost signed a partnership with FindMe on 1 November 2024 in Yaounde to enhance the national address system](<https://www.businessincameroon.com/public-management/0411-14292-cameroon-s-campost-partners-with-findme-to-improve-national-address-system>). The addresses are certified through national postal partnerships. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[ARPCE's postal regulation director reported progress on the national digital addressing platform, provisionally named Système de localisation mixte](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/economie-postale-la-revolution-de-ladressage-national-touche-au-160394>). It was demonstrated at a steering committee on 9 October 2024. In the last twelve months, [on 15 October 2026 ARPCE presented its digital postal addressing project, run with town halls since April 2022](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/livre-blanc-et-adressage-postal-larpce-pose-les-fondations-de-letat-numerique-172016>). No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In August 2024 Comores Infos reported that the Comoros has no postcodes and no precise way to locate places](<https://www.comoresinfos.net/le-ministre-des-telecommunications-envisage-dinstaurer-des-codes-postaux-aux-comores-pour-favoriser-le-developpement/>). [The telecoms minister has pledged to introduce postcodes](<https://www.comoresinfos.net/le-ministre-des-telecommunications-envisage-dinstaurer-des-codes-postaux-aux-comores-pour-favoriser-le-developpement/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an addressing system is under way. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[The Câmara Municipal da Praia launched its Plataforma Municipal de Toponímia in October 2025](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2026/04/04/ja-esta-disponivel-a-plataforma-de-toponimia-da-cmp/102191>). [In April 2026 it said the platform lets residents find street names and official building numbers across the Praia municipality](<https://expressodasilhas.cv/pais/2026/04/04/ja-esta-disponivel-a-plataforma-de-toponimia-da-cmp/102191>). In the last twelve months, [in November 2026 São Filipe's council was matching inventoried names to its streets and squares](<https://www.balai.cv/noticias/sao-filipe-projecto-de-toponimia-avanca-para-associacao-de-nomes-as-vias-largos-e-pracas-do-municipio/>). No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[Terms of reference for the PROGOUV programme, dated November 2023, say street addressing in Djibouti city exists only in a few central streets and in Ras Dika commune](<https://expertise-france.gestmax.fr/_expertise_france/public_files/progouv-tdr-expert-amo-sig-et-adressage-v23-11-2023.pdf>). Those streets have plates but no door numbers, and a pilot ran in Cité Nassib in Balbala. The city council was recruiting an expert to define a city addressing strategy. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[On 12 October 2026 the interior ministry's director general Amal Djouama said 1.5 million official, geolocated addresses had been counted under the national address reference](<https://arabe.capdz.dz/archives/144046>), with the rollout in 12 wilayas. [The ministry's plan extends the unified addressing system to all 69 wilayas by 2030](<https://arabe.capdz.dz/archives/144046>). [El Khabar names five users of the system at a study day in Oran on 12 October 2026](<https://www.elkhabar.com.dz/fr/societe/adressage-le-recensement-se-poursuit-265174>), among them civil protection, Sonelgaz and the tax services. No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[In June 2025 the communications ministry said about 19 million national real estate identification numbers had been issued across several governorates](<http://mcit.gov.eg/en/Media_Center/Press_Room/Press_Releases/68471>). The ministry said the digital system to manage them was still being developed ahead of its launch. [In March 2020 Egypt Post's chairperson said a new seven-digit postcode had been applied across the country](<https://www.dailynewsegypt.com/2020/03/09/egypt-post-applies-new-postcode-system-with-dhl/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the digital system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

In December 2025 [SSGI said eDAS was in use in 73 cities](<https://ssgi.gov.et/edas-for-three-cities/>). [In January 2026 SSGI's Director General said the system was being rolled out in stages across several cities](<https://ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_8039305>). [In December 2025 SSGI's Deputy Director General said eDAS integrates the Fayda digital ID](<https://ssgi.gov.et/edas-for-three-cities/>), and it also integrates postal and parcel delivery services. [In October 2026 the Minister of Innovation and Technology said the system should be expanded nationwide](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/27/ethiopia-national-geospatial-data-infrastructure-strategy/>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

[Street naming and door numbering in Libreville stopped at the end of 2021](<https://gabonmediatime.com/libreville-reprise-de-loperation-dadressage/>). [By March 2025 the work had resumed, with 5,000 of 60,000 door numbers placed](<https://gabonmediatime.com/libreville-reprise-de-loperation-dadressage/>). [AIMF and the EU fund the work](<https://gabonmediatime.com/libreville-reprise-de-loperation-dadressage/>), which is Libreville's municipal programme. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[Ghana Post's site says GhanaPostGPS is Ghana's official digital property addressing system, giving every location a unique digital address](<https://www.ghanapostgps.com/>). [It says the system covers every inch of the country and all locations are addressed](<https://www.ghanapostgps.com/>). [An academic evaluation says the system had been in implementation nearly six years](<http://web.archive.org/web/20240423090918/https://journalajrcos.com/index.php/AJRCOS/article/view/430>), and that it might be a partial failure. No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says other services use the address system. Mature would need the post, emergency services, utilities or other registers to use the address system.

[On 3 October 2024 the urbanism minister Mory Condé said the national addressing programme was complete in Kaloum](<https://www.africaguinee.com/adressage-des-rues-a-kaloum-les-explications-de-mory-conde-ministre-lurbanisme-et-de-lhabitat/>). He said it would extend to Dixinn, Matam, the other Conakry communes, Coyah, Dubréka and regional and prefecture towns. [An order of 25 August 2025 created a management unit for the National Addressing Programme under the urbanism minister](<https://legisguinee.com/textes/arrete-2025-800-unite-gestion-programme-national-adressage>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

In June 2026 [Kanifing Municipal Council was bringing in sequential street numbers](<https://www.kerrfatou.com/kmc-says-digital-address-codes-will-improve-emergency-response-and-property-tax-collection/>), beside its Plus Codes shown on compound gates. LoGRI says Kanifing [gave Plus Code addresses to 500,000 residents](<https://logri.org/publication/implementing-a-comprehensive-digital-addressing-system-a-step-by-step-guide-inspired-by-the-experience-of-kanifing-municipality-the-gambia>), georeferencing 36,000 properties. In November 2026 the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy [held a West Coast Region forum on the National Digital Addressing Initiative](<https://thepoint.gm/africa/gambia/national-news/digital-ministry-moves-to-promote-national-digital-addressing-initiative>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether Guinea-Bissau has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[The Communications Authority of Kenya has led the draft National Addressing System Bill, 2025](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/02/kenya-and-lesotho-deepen-ict-regulatory-cooperation-on-national-addressing-system/>). [It wrote national addressing standards with the Kenya Bureau of Standards](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/02/kenya-and-lesotho-deepen-ict-regulatory-cooperation-on-national-addressing-system/>). [In Parliament the Bill's sponsor said Kenya relies on informal dropped-pin location sharing](<https://www.parliament.go.ke/node/25958>). [In September 2026 the National Addressing System Bill was still a draft](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/02/kenya-and-lesotho-deepen-ict-regulatory-cooperation-on-national-addressing-system/>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In February 2026 the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications published Digital Liberia, its Strategic Plan 2025-2029](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/02/03/liberia-unveils-5-year-digital-liberia-strategy/>). [It makes a national digital addressing system one of eight priority areas](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/02/03/liberia-unveils-5-year-digital-liberia-strategy/>). [On 6 July 2026 the ministry announced that deployment had begun in Montserrado County](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0807-57188-liberia-begins-rollout-of-national-digital-address-system>). It is to expand to all 15 counties. No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[At the start of 2025 Libya Post began installing address plates in several municipalities](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=334874&lang=ar>). [Its first phase numbers 42,000 buildings, with more than 23 municipalities to follow](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=334874&lang=ar>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 an experts forum in Tripoli urged faster work on the Digital Addressing Platform](<https://libyaherald.com/2026/08/libyan-experts-forum-makes-several-wide-ranging-recommendations-to-support-libya>), which the Libya Herald reports as already being implemented. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In October 2026 the Government of Lesotho said a standard digital address was still missing](<https://www.gov.ls/development/lesotho-government-is-poised-to-benefit-significantly-from-world-bank-as-its-on-a-vital-mission-to-tackle-youth-unemployment-through-innovative-digital-public-works-programs/>). [A World Bank urban team has expressed interest in supporting a nationwide Digital Address system](<https://www.gov.ls/development/lesotho-government-is-poised-to-benefit-significantly-from-world-bank-as-its-on-a-vital-mission-to-tackle-youth-unemployment-through-innovative-digital-public-works-programs/>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an addressing system is under way. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[On 22 December 2023 the commune of Beni Ansar met Barid Al-Maghrib on its project for a street-naming and house-numbering system](<https://bninsar.ma/wp/archives/15168>). [The meeting was the first in a series of workshops to complete the system across the commune](<https://bninsar.ma/wp/archives/15168>). [Article 85 of the organic law and decree 2.17.307 of July 2017 provide for such a system](<https://bninsar.ma/wp/archives/15168>). The project covers one commune. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

In July 2024 L'Express reported that the tax directorate DGI [was training staff of Antsiranana commune to set up addressing and tax census operations](<https://www.lexpress.mg/2024/07/antsiranana-des-efforts-pour-booster.html>). Drones were to survey the town before the address database was built. The work concerns one commune. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says an address register or digital addressing system is in service in Madagascar, or how far the Antsiranana work went. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

In March 2025 the permanent secretary for land reform [said Ninacad-Adresse gives each plot a six-digit code in a secure database](<https://www.maliweb.net/habitationsparcelles/digitalisation-de-ladministration-ninacad-adresse-pour-vite-geolocaliser-les-parcelles-3098978.html>), reaching about 1,500,000 plots in Bamako and parts of Kati and Ségou. In the last twelve months, in January 2026, the DGI [said the application was at its design phase](<https://www.dgi.gouv.ml/du-ninacad-adresse-bientot-disponible-au-mali/>). No source found says it is in service. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[On 3 October 2025 the Ministry of State Administration and Public Service launched postal addressing in Marracuene, Maputo province, under Decree 74/2024](<https://ngani.co.mz/politica/04/10/2025/marracuene-da-inicio-ao-processo-de-enderecamento-postal/>). [The work names and numbers streets and buildings, puts up street signs and builds a geographic database](<https://ngani.co.mz/politica/04/10/2025/marracuene-da-inicio-ao-processo-de-enderecamento-postal/>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 the Council of Ministers approved 1,444 geographic names](<https://integritymagazine.co.mz/arquivos/71359>). [On 21 October 2026 INCM presented the new eight-digit postal code in Pemba](<http://www.semfronteirasfm.org/2026/10/incm-divulga-novo-codigo-de.html>). No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[On 29 September 2026 the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernization presented a national digital addressing system](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0110-59390-mauritania-plans-end-2026-pilot-of-digital-addressing-system-to-support-e-commerce>). [Ecofin Agency reports that a pilot is expected by the end of 2026](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0110-59390-mauritania-plans-end-2026-pilot-of-digital-addressing-system-to-support-e-commerce>). [In November 2026 the country still had no general postal addressing system, which makes deliveries harder](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/mauritanie-de-6-5-a-20-d-acheteurs-en-ligne-le-pari-d-un-nouveau-marche-numerique>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether Mauritius has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[In February 2024 MACRA said it coordinates the National Addressing System Project](<https://macra.mw/national-addressing-project/>). [Its deliverables include street naming, property numbering and a national address database](<https://macra.mw/national-addressing-project/>). [In April 2025 MACRA said it had rolled out the system to all districts](<https://www.nyasatimes.com/macra-rolls-out-national-addressing-system/>), with street naming being finalised. In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 MACRA said 472,674 properties had been assigned numbers and 11,367 streets officially named](<https://thetruthmw.com/2026/08/29/472674-properties-get-addresses/>). No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In April 2026 Emilia Nghikembua, Chief Executive of CRAN, spoke of developing a National Addressing System](<https://economist.com.na/106279/general-news/communications-regulator-and-nsa-sign-landmark-agreement-to-bolster-national-data-integrity/>). [She spoke in the context of a data-sharing agreement between CRAN and the NSA](<https://economist.com.na/106279/general-news/communications-regulator-and-nsa-sign-landmark-agreement-to-bolster-national-data-integrity/>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service, or that the addressing system covers the whole country. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In October 2026 the Agence de Modernisation des Villes said its Niamey addressing geoportal lists more than 3,500 streets of the capital](<http://www.modernisation-villes.ne/geoportail/pages/about.html>). [GéoMinds Africa built it with data the city validated](<http://www.modernisation-villes.ne/geoportail/pages/about.html>). [A tender closing on 30 June 2025 sought to update and extend Niamey's urban addressing system](<http://www.modernisation-villes.ne/fr/node/110>). No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No source found since October 2023 says the addressing system covers the whole country. Operating would need the addressing system to cover the whole country, rural areas included.

The federal executive council [approved a national digital addressing policy](<https://www.thecable.ng/spotted-nipost-digital-postcode-website-exposes-names-of-homeowners>) and a digital postcode system in March 2026. The Nigerian Postal Service (NIPOST) [switched on the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode](<https://spaceinafrica.com/2026/10/03/inside-nigerias-digital-postcode-the-gis-and-satellite-data-behind-11-characters/>) on 1 October 2026. [The system assigns a code to every addressable building in the country](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/10/29/from-informal-landmarks-to-sovereign-data-the-governance-challenge-facing-digital-postcodes/>), Tech Africa News reported in October 2026. No earlier dated position has been found, so no change in the last twelve months is shown. No use of the postcode by another public service is recorded. In July 2026 the identity commission and NIPOST [signed a memorandum to put postcode retrieval on the national identity platform](<https://theindustryng.com/fg-revives-digital-postcode-after-20-years-begins-nin-integration/>). Mature would need the post, emergency services, utilities or other registers to use the address system.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether Rwanda has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 says whether Sudan has a national addressing system, or whether one is under way or in service. Nothing has been found in the last twelve months that says addressing is absent. No dated source from the past three years has been found for the country. Preparing would need a national addressing policy adopted, or street naming, numbering or digital addressing under way in some cities.

[The project began in 2021 and was presented in 2023 as 'Un Senegalais, une adresse', We are Tech reports](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/senegal-le-projet-d-adressage-numerique-national-entre-dans-une-nouvelle-phase>). In the last twelve months, [on 5 August 2026 the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs opened a two-day workshop relaunching the National Digital Addressing (ANN) project](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6646/senegal-relaunches-national-digital-addressing-project>). [It aims at a unified, georeferenced national address database](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/6646/senegal-relaunches-national-digital-addressing-project>). [A pilot is due within a year, before gradual national extension](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/senegal-le-projet-d-adressage-numerique-national-entre-dans-une-nouvelle-phase>). No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In 2024 Sierra Loaded reported a partnership to digitise physical addresses in Sierra Leone](<https://sierraloaded.sl/technology/google-maps-dsti-digitize-physical-addresses-sierra-leone/>). The partners are Google Maps and the Directorate of Science, Technology and Innovation. A digital address system for homes was described as forthcoming. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says an address register or digital addressing system is in service, or that the addressing system covers the whole country. Establishing would need an address register or digital addressing system in service.

[In December 2024 CBC reported that Karaar Digital Address had run several test pilots in Somalia, including in Merca](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/edmonton-somalia-business-innovation-remittance-1.7417321>). [It has memorandums of understanding with four states and regions](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/edmonton-somalia-business-innovation-remittance-1.7417321>).
